notes: Universal companion AI 0.8.4 COMPACT+SPELLFIX. Restores a compact 330x350 panel with fresh geometry, keeps all controls, and shows all six abilities on one compact line. Prepared spell display groups duplicates, e.g. a repeated spell is shown as x4 with ready-count if some slots are spent. Fixes cleric/druid/wizard/paladin/ranger prebuff detection by scanning ready memorized slots instead of relying only on GetHasSpell, so prepared Bless and other divine buffs can be queued. Preserves 0.8.3 auto-heal, rogue utility, Turn Undead, familiar exclusion and party-slot fixes.
